extension.summary: Retro cable TV from your own library - flip channels, not menus.
extension.description: CableBox 42 turns your Kodi library into a live cable TV lineup. Shows air on a real-time schedule with commercial breaks and bumps from your own clip folders, a scrolling program guide channel, a retro weather channel, static between channels and a channel banner. Lineups build themselves from your library (genres, decades, studios, tags, smart playlists or folders) and can be fine-tuned show by show - there is no schedule to compile. Playback uses Kodi's own player, so hardware decoding works exactly as it does for the rest of your library.[CR][CR]Inspired by the FieldStation42 project; not affiliated with it.
extension.disclaimer: Plays only media from your own Kodi library and folders. The optional weather channel uses Kodi's weather service or, if you enter a location, fetches forecasts from open-meteo.com.
extension.news: v1.1.0 - everything since 1.0.0 - Broadcast networks on 3-5 with a network-style day; shows go to the station for the network they aired on - Built-in stations with logos and call letters, branding by time of day (CAM Jr. mornings), corner logo bug - Station folders: your own logos, bumps, IDs and commercials per channel and time block; Branding & clips shows what each channel really uses; exact folder matching; renaming a channel renames its folder - Shows without a good channel: shows nothing picks up or that only just fit, with the reason - move, keep or hide them - Lineup summary after setup and in the Channel manager - Closed captions: CC on/off for every programme (main menu or Menu button), track choice, subtitle files, online search, remote CC button, forced subtitles, works on CoreELEC/Android boxes - TV turn-on/turn-off effect with sound, static modes, no loading wheel, retro weather icons - Disc images, Blu-ray folders and .strm files fully supported - New HOWTO.md guide; full history in changelog.txt
